name: NetBox
description: Imports your documented network from NetBox (4.x): devices with a network role (router, switch, access point ...) become network nodes, every other device a client, and the cables between interfaces decide who hangs below whom, including the port a device is plugged into. Netlens matches them to what it finds on the network by MAC address, so the hierarchy shows your documentation. Read-only: it only sends GET requests with an API token that has read-only permissions.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
